title: Write the Missing Deduction Guide
prompt: `Box`'s iterator-pair constructor deduces the iterator type by default — `Box<int*>` instead of `Box<int>`. Write the deduction guide that steers CTAD to the element type.

tests.name: CTAD lands on the element type
tests.hint:
template <class It>
Box(It first, It last) -> Box<std::iter_value_t<It>>; (or std::iterator_traits<It>::value_type).
